blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Linear probes on a model's hidden states are used as cheap monitors for indirect prompt injection: they screen the tool outputs an agent reads and send suspicious ones to a slower second check, so every false alarm has a cost. But a probe learns whatever separates its training examples. The standard evaluation of injection probes can be passed without the model: conversation position and text lengths alone reach 0.91-0.98 AUROC. When each attack is compared with the same conversation without the injection, or with harmless text formatted like an injection, standard probes flag most of these harmless cases. We add such cases to the training data as matched negatives. Across six open models, in applications seen during training and at the default threshold, changing only the training data cuts false alarms on injection-free conversations from 41-80% to 4-27%, and on harmless look-alikes from 92-98% to 3-16%. With a threshold set on normal traffic, our probe still catches a median 95% of the attacks that fooled the agent (91% without our data). In new applications, false alarms stay low, but detection depends on the model and on how the threshold is set. The same data also helps a text-only filter.
blocks.zh: 模型所隐藏状态上的线性探测器被用作间接即时注射的廉价显示器:它们筛选工具输出出一个代理读取,并发送出可疑的探测器到较慢的第二次检查,因此每个假警报都有成本. 但探测器会知道 任何能区分其训练实例的东西 注射探针的标准评价可以在没有模型的情况下通过:对话位置和文本长度单独达到0.91-0.98 AUROC. 当每次攻击被比作没有注射的同一种对话,或者用像注射一样无害的文字格式,标准探测器标出大多数这些无害的病例. 在培训数据中,我们把此类案例与负数相匹配。 在6个开放型号中,在培训期间和默认阈值的应用中,只改变培训数据将无注射对话的假警报从41-80%减少到4-27%,将无害外观从92-98%减少到3-16%。 我们的探测器仍能捕捉95%的中位数攻击, 在新的应用中,假警报保持低水平,但检测取决于模型和阈值的设定方式. 同样的数据也帮助了一个仅文本过滤器.

blocks.en: Language-model agents call tools on a user’s behalf: they read emails, browse web pages and edit files, and much of what they read is written by others. In an indirect prompt injection , an attacker places instructions in such content and the agent follows them instead of its user’s request ( Greshake et al., 2023 ) . Such attacks have already been demonstrated on deployed products: a single crafted email made Microsoft 365 Copilot send internal data to an attacker without the user clicking anything ( Reddy and Gujral, 2025 ) ; a message in a public GitHub issue made an agent publish data from its user’s private repositories in a public pull request ( Milanta and Beurer-Kellner, 2025 ) ; and a message in a public Slack channel made Slack AI leak content from private channels through a link it showed the user ( PromptArmor, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 语言模型代理代表用户调用工具:他们读取电子邮件,浏览网页并编辑文件,他们读取的大部分是他人所写的. 在间接的即时注射中,攻击者在这种内容中放出指示,而代理者遵循这些指示而不是用户的要求(Greshake等,2023年)。 这些攻击已经在已部署的产品上得到展示:一个制作的单个邮件使Microsoft 365 Copilot将内部数据发送给攻击者,而用户没有点击任何东西(Reddy和Gujral,2025年);一个公开的GitHub 发的一条消息让代理在公开的拉取请求(Milanta和Beurer-Kellner,2025年)中发布用户私人寄存器的数据;以及一个公开的Slack频道的一条消息让Slack AI通过向用户显示的链接泄露了来自私人频道的内容(Power Armor,2024年).

blocks.en: Deployed defenses are layered. A fast first filter screens every tool output, and only what it flags goes to a slower and more expensive second check , such as a second language model that reads the conversation ( Chennabasappa et al., 2025 ; Cunningham et al., 2026 ) . The second check is the bottleneck: an LLM-based detector takes on the order of a second per item ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Because benign traffic far outweighs attacks, a detector is only usable with a very low false-positive rate ( Jacob et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . A first filter does not block anything itself, but each of its false alarms costs one more second check.
blocks.zh: 部署的防御工事是分层的。 一个快速的首个过滤屏显示每个工具的输出,只有它所标出的东西去一个更慢更昂贵的第二次检查,比如读取对话的第二语言模型(Chennabasappa等,2025;Cunningham等,2026). 第二次检查是瓶颈:一个基于LLM的探测器按每件第二件的顺序进行(张等,2026年). 因为良性交通远大于攻击,因此检测器只能使用极低的假阳性率(Jacob等,2025;张等,2026. 第一个过滤器本身不会屏蔽任何东西,但每个错误的警报都需再检查一秒钟。

blocks.en: A linear probe on the agent’s own hidden states is an attractive first filter, because it reuses computation the model performs anyway. Probes are already used this way: Anthropic runs prompt-injection probes on tool outputs across many of its products ( Anthropic, 2026 ) . Probes for other risks are deployed in production as well, and putting them in front of larger classifiers cuts cost by more than an order of magnitude ( Cunningham et al., 2026 ; Kramár et al., 2026 ) . For multi-turn agents, linear probes trained to detect injections reach held-out AUROC of 0.93–0.98 ( Dong et al., 2026 ) . We study the evaluation protocol behind such scores, which we call the standard evaluation .
blocks.zh: 在代理商隐藏状态上的线性探测器是首个有吸引力的过滤器,因为它可以重复计算模型的功能。 探测器已经以这种方式使用:Anthropic对其许多产品(Anthropic,2026年)的工具输出进行即时注射探测. 其他风险的探测器也部署在生产中,放在较大的分类器前,成本减少的幅度超过一个数量级(Cunningham等人,2026;Kramár等人,2026)。 对于多转子剂,经培训检测注射的线性探测器达到0.93-0.98(Dong等,2026年)。 我们研究这些评分背后的评价协议,我们称之为标准评价。

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows how such probes are trained and tested. An agent run starts with a user request and continues through several tool calls; we call each point just before the agent acts a moment . A moment is positive if the agent has just read a tool output that contains injected text, and negative otherwise. In the standard evaluation, the negatives are the other moments of attacked runs: before the injection arrived, or after it, when the agent reads an ordinary tool output. Positives therefore differ from negatives not only in the injection, but also in when they occur and in how much text the agent has just read.
blocks.zh: 图1显示这些探测器是如何被训练和测试的。 一个代理运行从用户请求开始,然后通过几个工具呼叫继续运行;我们在代理运行一刻之前就给每个点打电话. . 如果代理刚刚读取了包含被注入文本的工具输出, 而非阴性, 则一瞬间为正数 。 在标准评价中,底片是被攻击跑跑的其他时刻:在注射到来之前,或者在注射后,当代理读取了普通工具输出时. 因此,阳性不仅在注射时与阴性不同,而且在出现时和剂刚读出多少正文时也不同.

blocks.en: A probe, like any classifier, learns whatever separates its positive and negative training examples, and that need not be the property we care about ( Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ; Belinkov, 2022 ) . Classifiers routinely learn such shortcuts ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ; McCoy et al., 2019 ; Gururangan et al., 2018 ) , and probes used for safety have been caught tracking the setting rather than the behavior: a deception probe fires on deception-related conversations even when the response is honest ( Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2025 ) . For an injection monitor, a shortcut has a concrete cost: it raises false alarms on harmless content that shares the shortcut, and the second check pays for each one. The usual safeguard, checking that performance holds on held-out data, cannot catch a shortcut that is present in both the training and the test data, such as the position in the conversation. We make three contributions. 1. Training with matched negatives. We add clean runs of the same tasks, which contain each attack’s clean twin (the same moment without the injection), and harmless text in the attack’s formatting (a look-alike ). Clean runs remove the position shortcut, and look-alikes remove the formatting shortcut. The fix changes only the training data, so it also helps a text-only classifier (§ 5 , § 6 ). 2. An evaluation in deployment terms on six open models from four families, both in applications the probes were trained on and in new ones. Besides AUROC, we report how many successful attacks each probe stops with thresholds set without test labels, and the second checks this costs. We separate the effect of the training data from that of the classifier (§ 6 ). 3. A breakdown of the shortcut , extending Li et al. (2026) from one multimodal web agent to six text agents: conversation statistics alone score 0.91–0.98 AUROC in the standard evaluation, mostly from position. Against clean twins and look-alikes, probes trained the standard way flag most harmless cases (§ 4 ).
blocks.zh: 探险者与任何分类者一样,都了解其正面和负面的训练实例,而这并不需要我们关心的财产(Hewitt和Liang,2019;Belinkov,2022)。 分类者经常学习这种快捷方式(Geirhos等,2020年;McCoy等,2019年;Gururangan等,2018年),安全使用的探测器被捕获跟踪设定而非行为:即使回应诚实,欺骗性探测器也会在与欺骗有关的谈话上起火(Goldowsky-Dill等,2025年). 对于注射显示器来说,快捷键有具体的成本:在共享快捷键的无害内容上引起虚假的警报,第二次检查则支付每一次费用. 通常的保障措施,即检查被搁置数据上的性能,无法抓住培训和测试数据中都存在的捷径,如对话中的位置。 我们作出了三项贡献。 1. 配备相应负数的培训。 我们添加了同样的任务的干净运行,包含每个攻击的干净双胞胎(没有注射的同时刻),以及攻击格式中无害的文字(类似外观). clean 运行去除位置快捷键,外观类似删除格式快捷键. 固定只改变培训数据,因此也帮助一个只使用文本的分类器(§5,§6). 2. 对来自四个家庭的6个开放型号进行部署评价,无论是在应用方面,还是对探测器进行新的应用培训。 除了AUROC之外,我们报告每个探测器有多少次在没有测试标签的情况下设定了阈值的成功攻击被停止,第二次则检查了这一成本. 我们把培训数据与分类数据的效果分开(第6节)。 3. 捷径的分解,将Li等人(2026年)从一个多模式网络代理扩大到六个文本代理:对话统计在标准评价中得分为0.91-0.98 AUROC,大多来自位置。 针对干净的双胞胎和长相相似者,探测器训练了标出最无害病例的标准方法(第4节)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Indirect prompt injection was introduced as an attack on LLM-integrated applications ( Greshake et al., 2023 ) and is evaluated end to end in agent benchmarks such as AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) , InjecAgent ( Zhan et al., 2024 ) and ASB ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . It exploits the weak separation between instructions and data in language models ( Zverev et al., 2024 ) . Frontier models are more robust but remain vulnerable, especially to adaptive attacks ( Shi et al., 2025 ; Dziemian et al., 2026 ) , and capability does not imply robustness ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Deployed defenses pair a fast detector such as Prompt Guard ( Meta, 2025 ) with slower LLM-based checks ( Chennabasappa et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 间接即时注射被作为攻击LLM-集成应用(Greshake等,2023年)引入,并被评价为以Agent Dojo(Debederetti等,2024年),InjecAgent(Zhan等,2024年)和ASB(Zhang等,2025年)等剂基准为终点. 它利用了语言模型中指令与数据的弱分化(Zverev等,2024.). 边疆模型更坚固,但仍然脆弱,尤其容易受到适应性攻击(Shi等,2025;Dziemian等,2026;能力并不意味着坚固(Debederetti等,2024;Zhang等,2025)。 已部署的防御工事配对了如"快速卫士"(Meta,2025)等快速探测器,并采用较慢的LLM检查(Chennabasappa等,2025;Wang等,2026).

blocks.en: TaskTracker detects task drift from the difference between activations before and after the model reads external data ( Abdelnabi et al., 2025 ) , so its comparison holds the conversation fixed. Attention Tracker uses attention heads whose focus shifts to an injected instruction ( Hung et al., 2025 ) ; InstructDetector and PIShield classify internal states of prompts that contain injected instructions ( Wen et al., 2025 ; Zou et al., 2025 ) ; and role probes show injected text being represented as the role it imitates ( Ye et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) . Dong et al. (2026) train linear probes on multi-turn AgentDojo agents and report near-perfect detection; we use their pipeline for our standard probe. Probes have also been proposed as cheap monitors for other risks ( McKenzie et al., 2025 ) . An attacker who knows that a probe is watching can optimize inputs so that the hidden states look harmless ( Bailey et al., 2026 ) ; we do not study such adaptive attacks.
blocks.zh: TaskTracker检测到在模型读取了外部数据(Abdelnabi等,2025年)前后激活的差分,任务漂移,因此其比较维持了对话的固定. 注意追踪器使用注意力头,其焦点转向注入指令(Hung等,2025年;指示探测器和PIShield将含有注入指令的内部提示状态分类(Wen等,2025年;Zou等,2025年;角色探测器显示被注入文本作为其模仿的角色(Ye等,2026年;Yu等,2026年)). 董等 (2026年) 将线性探测器训练在多转子代理道克剂上,并报告近乎完美的探测;我们用他们的管道进行我们的标准探测. 也有人提议将探测器作为其他风险的廉价监测器(McKenzie等,2025年)。 一个知道探测器正在观察的攻击者可以优化输入,使隐藏状态看起来无害(Bailey等人,2026年);我们不研究这种适应性攻击.

blocks.en: High probe accuracy need not mean that a property is represented the way the probe suggests, or that the model uses it ( Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ; Belinkov, 2022 ; Ravichander et al., 2021 ; Elazar et al., 2021 ) , and classifiers in general learn shortcuts that happen to separate the training labels ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ; Gururangan et al., 2018 ; McCoy et al., 2019 ) . Safety probes are no exception: truth and deception probes have been shown to follow correlates of the property ( Levinstein and Herrmann, 2025 ; Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2025 ) , which motivates training on minimal contrasts such as statements paired with their negations ( Marks and Tegmark, 2024 ) . Our matched negatives apply the idea of contrast sets and counterfactual examples ( Gardner et al., 2020 ; Kaushik et al., 2020 ) to probe training. Closest to us, Li et al. (2026) show for one multimodal web agent that a metadata baseline reaches AUC 1.000, and propose comparisons at the same step as evaluation controls. We extend this to six text agents over many steps, break the shortcut down into position, length and formatting, train probes that remove it, and measure what it costs a deployed monitor.
blocks.zh: 高探测精度并不一定意味着一个属性代表了探测所暗示的方式,或者模型使用了它(Hewitt和Liang, 2019;Belinkov, 2022; Ravichander等, 2021; Elazar等, 2021;),一般的分类者学习了可能将训练标签分开的捷径(Geirhos等, 2020;Gurururangan等, 2018;McCoy等, 2019). 安全探测器也不例外:事实和欺骗探测器被证明跟随了地产的关联(Levinstein和Herrmann,2025;Goldowsky-Dill等人,2025),这激励了对最小对比性的培训,如声明与他们的否定相配(Marks和Tegmark,2024). 我们的对应底片将对比集和反事实实例的概念(Gardner等人,2020年;Kaushik等人,2020年)用于探测培训。 与我们最接近的是,Li等人(2026年)就一个多模式网络代理显示,元数据基线达到AUC 1.000,并提议与评价控制相同步骤进行比较。 我们通过许多步骤将它扩展到六个文本代理, 将快捷键细分为位置,长度和格式化, 列车探测器去除它, 并测量它花费多少部署的显示器。

blocks.en: AgentDojo simulates four applications: banking, an office workspace (email, calendar, files), Slack, and travel booking. Each has its own tools, user tasks (“pay my bill”) and attacker tasks (“send money to this account”). An injection places an attacker task in the application’s data, for example inside a file or an email, using one of six attack templates (Appendix D ). Some prefix the attacker task with a single phrase ( TODO: , “Ignore your previous instructions”, ###(system_message) ); others wrap it in a formatted block addressed to the agent and signed by the user. We build all our test cases from attacks that use one template, AgentDojo’s important_instructions block, which we call the formatted template : its clear start and end markers let us replace its content with harmless text or strip its wrapper. A run combines one user task with one attacker task and one template, or with no injection (a clean run ). We collect runs on every pair of user task and attacker task, with all six templates and clean runs, one sample each: about 23,000 runs per model (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: Agent Dojo模拟了四个应用程序:银行,一个办公工作空间(电子邮件,日历,文件),Slack,以及旅行预订. 每个公司都有自己的工具、用户任务(“付帐”)和攻击者任务(“寄钱给这个帐户”)。 注入会将攻击者的任务放入应用程序的数据中,比如在文件或电子邮件中,使用六个攻击模板中的一个(Appendix D. 一些前缀攻击者的任务有一个单词组(TODO:"忽略您以前的指令",QQ(system_message);另一些则用格式块将它包入给代理商,并由用户签名. 我们用一个模板(Agent Dojo's impressional_instructions block)来构建所有测试案例, 跑会结合一个用户任务和一个攻击者任务和一个模板,或者没有注入(一个干净跑会. 我们收集每对用户任务和攻击者任务上的运行,所有6个模板和干净运行,每个样本:每个模型大约2.3万个运行(附录A.

blocks.en: We call text in a tool output an injection when it asks the agent to do something other than what its user requested. A harmless instruction addressed to a human reader, such as a request to bring a laptop to a meeting, is therefore not an injection, although it reads like one. Real tool outputs are full of such text, and we report false alarms on it separately.
blocks.zh: 我们称工具中的文本输出一个注入, 当它要求代理人做一些与其用户要求无关的事情。 因此,向人类读者发出无害的指令,例如要求携带一台笔记本电脑参加会议,并不是注射,尽管其读作类似。 真正的工具输出充满了这种文本,我们单独报告其中的虚假警报。

blocks.en: Probes need the model’s hidden states, so they suit open models that a team hosts itself, and agent builders increasingly route routine tool work to smaller, cheaper models ( OpenAI, 2025a ; Anthropic, 2025 ; Belcak et al., 2026 ) . We use six open models from four families: Qwen3-8B ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) , Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 ( NVIDIA, 2025b ) , Nemotron-3-Nano-30B ( NVIDIA, 2025a ) , gpt-oss-20b ( OpenAI, 2025b ) and Gemma-4-31B ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) , all with reasoning enabled. Under the formatted template, the agents carry out the attacker task in 9–30% of runs.
blocks.zh: 探测器需要模型的隐藏状态,因此它们适合一个团队自己主机的开放模型,代理构建者越来越多地将常规工具的工作导向更小,更便宜的模型(OpenAI,2025a;Anthropic,2025;Belcak等,2026). 我们使用来自4个家庭的6个开放型号:Quen3-8B(Quen Team,2025年),Quen3.5-9B(Quen Team,2026年),Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2(NVIDIA,2025b),Nemotron-3-Nano-30B(NVIDIA,2025a),gpt-oss-20b(OpenAI,2025b)和Gemma-4-31B. (Gemma Team, 2026), 都具备了推理功能. 在格式化模板下,代理在9-30%的运行中执行攻击者任务.

blocks.en: We follow the pipeline of Dong et al. (2026) . For every moment, we run the model once over the prompt and read its hidden state at every layer, at the last token before the agent’s reply begins. One linear probe per layer is trained with the standard labels (1 if the latest tool output contains injected text, 0 otherwise) using their recipe: standardized features, a linear layer trained with AdamW for five epochs, scores averaged over five seeds. We call this the standard probe . The standard data contains the moments of attacked runs with all six templates; it has no clean runs. To tell whether differences come from the training data or from the classifier, we also fit an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -regularized logistic regression on the same standard data.
blocks.zh: 我们跟随董等的管道(2026年). 在代理商回复开始前的最后一点, 每层一个线性探测器被训练有标准标签(如果最新的工具输出包含注入文本,0否则),使用它们的配方: 标准化特性,一个线性层,用亚当W训练的5个纪元,平均得分超过5个种子. 我们称之为标准探测器。 标准数据包含所有六个模板被攻击的瞬间;它没有干净的运行. 为了辨别来自训练数据还是来自分类器的差异,我们也适应了I 2\ell\\2}——在同一标准数据上规范的后勤回归。

blocks.en: For each moment right after the agent reads a formatted-template injection, we score five test cases at the same moment of the same task (Appendix C shows them for one task): ∙ \bullet real attack : the moment itself (should be flagged); ∙ \bullet plain-text attack : the attacker task without the formatting (should be flagged); ∙ \bullet clean twin : the same moment of the clean run of the same task (should not be flagged); in most pairs the two prompts are identical except for the injected text (Appendix B ); ∙ \bullet harmless look-alike : the same formatted block with a harmless notice instead of the attacker task (should not be flagged); ∙ \bullet harmless instruction : a harmless instruction to a human reader, such as “Please bring your laptop to Thursday’s workshop.”, in place of the injection (should not be flagged). Look-alikes and harmless instructions come from pools of 80 sentences each, split into disjoint training and test halves. No probe trains on harmless instructions.

blocks.zh: 实际攻击:瞬间本身(应标出);

blocks.zh: 纯文本攻击:没有格式化的攻击者任务(应当被标记);

blocks.en: A probe outputs a score, and a monitor flags a tool output when the score passes a threshold. We use three thresholds, none set with test labels: the default of 0.5; the training-app threshold , which flags 1% of the training applications’ normal tool outputs; and the test-app threshold , which flags 1% of the test application’s own normal tool outputs and needs no attack examples. To compare probes regardless of threshold, we also report AUROC and attacks caught when 5% of clean twins are flagged; both use test labels, so they are measures, not deployable settings.
blocks.zh: 探测器输出分数,而显示器在分数超过阈值时显示工具输出. 我们使用三个阈值,没有设置测试标签:默认为0.5;培训应用阈值,标出培训应用程序正常工具输出的1%;测试应用阈值,标出测试应用程序正常工具输出的1%,不需要攻击的例子。 为了比较探测器,不管阈值如何,我们也报告AUROC和当5%的干净双胞胎被标出时捕获的攻击;两者都使用测试标签,所以它们是措施,而不是可部署的设置.

blocks.en:
We test every probe in two settings, with the same training runs and the same test cases for all probes.
In seen applications , training and test come from the same four applications but from different tasks: we train on half of the user tasks and half of the attacker tasks, and test mainly on attacks on the other user tasks, with both seen and new attacker tasks (Appendix A ). This is a monitor deployed in the same product it was trained for.
In new applications , we train on two of the four applications and test on the other two, for example train on banking and Slack and test on travel and workspace, for all six pairs. Nothing in the test applications, neither their tools, their data nor their tasks, appears in training. This is a monitor deployed in a product it has not seen. Training on three applications and testing on the fourth gives similar results (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh:
我们在两种环境下测试每一个探测器, 相同的训练运行, 相同的测试案例 所有探测器。
在所见的应用程序中,培训和测试来自同一个四个应用程序,但来自不同的任务:我们训练一半的用户任务和一半的攻击者任务,并主要测试对其他用户任务的攻击,同时进行所见和新的攻击者任务(Appendix A. 这是安装在它所训练的同一种产品的监视器。
在新的应用中,我们按四种应用中的两种进行训练,并按其他两种进行试验,例如,对银行和Slack的训练和对旅行和工作空间的试验。 测试应用程序中没有任何内容,其工具、数据或任务都没有出现在培训中。 这是在它没有看到的产品中部署的监视器。 关于三个应用和关于第四个应用的测试的培训得出类似的结果(附录E.)。

blocks.en: Each probe picks its layer on a held-out 20% of its own training data. Scores there are near 1.0 at most layers, so among layers within 0.005 of the best we take the one closest to the middle of the model. Appendix E reports every layer.

blocks.en: 4 Shortcuts in the Standard Evaluation
blocks.zh: 标准评价中的4个快捷键

blocks.en: Table 1: Main results, medians over the six models ( ↑ \uparrow higher is better, ↓ \downarrow lower is better). Rows: the standard probe (§ 3 ), our classifier trained on the standard data, and ours, the same classifier trained with matched negatives (§ 5 ). AUROC : real attack against its clean twin. Twin , Look , Instr. : % of clean twins, harmless look-alikes and harmless instructions flagged at the default threshold; Plain : % of plain-text attacks flagged; Stop : % of successful attacks (those the agent fell for) flagged with the training-app threshold. Per-model numbers in Figure 2 and Appendix E .

Following Li et al. (2026) , we fit a conversation-statistics baseline : a logistic regression on seven numbers that never look at the model. Four describe the position in the conversation and three the lengths of the prompt and the tool outputs (Appendix A ). On the standard test it reaches 0.96–0.98 AUROC in seen applications and 0.91–0.96 in new ones, close to the standard probes (0.97–1.00; Figure 3 ). The four position numbers alone reach 0.80–0.86; the length numbers add the rest, because an injection makes the tool output longer. Where position no longer differs, the baseline drops to 0.65–0.75 AUROC against clean twins, which differ from the attack only by the injected text, and to 0.59–0.65 against look-alikes, which add text of a similar length. A high score in the standard evaluation therefore does not show that a probe detects the injection. These cues come from how AgentDojo is built (injections at predictable moments that usually add text); real traffic need not share them, so a monitor has to detect the injection itself.
blocks.zh: 继李等(2026年)之后,我们符合对话-统计基线:从不看模型的7个数字的后勤回归。 四是描述谈话中的位置,三是提示和工具输出的长度(附录A. 在标准试验中,在所见应用中它达到0.96-0.98AUROC,在新的应用中达到0.91-0.96,接近标准探测器(0.97-1.00;图3)。 仅4个位置数字就达到0.80–0.86;长度数字会增加其余部分,因为注射会使工具输出更长. 在位置不再有区别的地方,基线下降到0.65–0.75 AUROC对干净的双胞胎,这与只被注射出文字的攻击不同;而到0.59–0.65对外观相似,增加了类似长度的文字. 因此,标准评价中的高分并不能显示探测器检测到注射. 这些提示来自Agent Dojo的构建方式(在通常会添加文字的可预见时刻的注射);真正的流量不需要共享,因此一个监视器必须检测注射本身.

blocks.en: Against the clean twin, standard probes still rank the attack higher (a median AUROC of 0.87 in seen and 0.90 in new applications), so they do pick up part of the injection. But at the default threshold of 0.5 they flag most clean twins (a median 80% in seen and 70% in new applications), nearly all harmless look-alikes and most harmless instructions (Figure 2 , Table 1 ). A monitor with these false alarms reacts to the moment in the conversation and to instruction-like text as well as to the injected request.
blocks.zh: 针对干净的双胞胎,标准探测器仍然将攻击排序更高(可见的AUROC中位数为0.87,新应用为0.90),因此它们确实取回了部分注射. 但在0.5的默认阈值下,它们标出最干净的双胞胎(见效中位数为80%,新应用中位数为70%),几乎所有无害的外观和最无害的指令(图2,表1)。 带有这些假警报的监视器对谈话的瞬间和类似指令的文本以及被注入的请求作出反应.

blocks.en: 5 Training with Matched Negatives
blocks.zh: 5 培训与匹配负数

blocks.en: The shortcuts above are available because, in the standard data, the negatives differ from the positives in position or in what the agent read, and no negative shares their formatting. We add negatives that match the positives in what the probe should ignore and differ only in the injection. For each formatted-template attack in the training runs, we add its clean twin, which has the same position and the same tool output without the injection, and a harmless look-alike from the training half of the pool, which has the same position and formatting but a harmless request. We keep the other moments of attacked runs as negatives and add every moment of the clean runs, so the probe still sees ordinary traffic; because clean runs contain moments at every position, position alone no longer predicts the label. As positives we use the attacked moments from all six templates and, for each formatted-template attack, the attacker task as plain text, so that the formatting alone does not predict the label either. Using positives from the formatted template alone gives similar results but flags fewer plain-text attacks (Appendix E ). The classifier is the same ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -regularized logistic regression ( C = 0.05 C=0.05 , balanced classes) as above.
blocks.zh: 上面的快捷键可以使用,因为在标准数据中,负数与正数位置或代理读取的正数不同,没有负数分享其格式. 我们添加了与探测器应忽略的正数相符的负数,并且只在注射时有所不同. 对于训练运行中的每一起被格式化的进攻,我们添加其干净的双胞胎,该双胞胎在没有注射的情况下具有相同的位置和相同的工具输出,以及来自训练池一半的无害外观,它具有相同的位置和格式,但有一个无害的请求. 我们保留其他被攻击的瞬间作为负数并添加干净跑道的每一瞬间,因此探测器仍然看到普通的流量;因为干净跑道包含在每个位置的瞬间,单靠位置已经无法预测标签了. 作为正值,我们使用所有六个模板中被攻击的瞬间,并且,对于每一个格式化-模板攻击,攻击者的任务都是作为纯文本的,这样单格式化也不会预测标签. 仅使用格式化模板的正数就给出了类似的结果,但旗帜会减少纯文本攻击(Appendix E. 分类器与上文相同 l 2\ell\\2} - 常规物流回归(C = 0.05 C = 0.05,平衡类).

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the results and Figure 2 shows them per model. In applications seen during training, matched negatives remove most false alarms for every model: ours flags a median 17% of clean twins and 11% of look-alikes, against 80% and 98% for the standard probe, while still flagging nearly all plain-text attacks. Our classifier trained on the standard data still flags most twins and look-alikes, so the drop in false alarms comes from the training data. The ranking against the twin improves in two steps, from a median AUROC of 0.87 for the standard probe to 0.92 with our classifier on the standard data and 0.98 with matched negatives (Figure 3 ), while the standard evaluation scores all of them near 1.00 and cannot tell them apart. The results hold on test attacks whose attacker task is also new (Appendix E ). AgentDojo reuses one attacker account per application (one bank account in banking, one email address in workspace and travel), so part of this detection may come from these strings; new applications share none of them, and there ours still ranks attacks above their twins (AUROC 0.92).
blocks.zh: 表1汇总了结果,图2显示了每个模型的结果。 在训练期间的应用中,匹配的底片消除了每个模型中大多数的假警报:我们旗下有中位数17%的干净双胞胎和11%的外观相像,而标准探测器则标出80%和98%,同时仍然标出几乎所有的纯文本攻击. 我们接受过标准数据训练的分类员 仍然标出大多数双胞胎和长相, 所以假警报的下降来自于训练数据。 相对于双子的排名在两个步骤上有所改进,从标准探测器的中位数AUROC为0.87,到标准数据上我们的分类器的0.92和相匹配的负数(图3)的0.98,而标准评价的得分都接近1.00,无法区分. 测试结果对攻击者的任务也是新的(附录E.)的测试攻击具有影响。 探员 Dojo每个应用程序重用一个攻击者账户(银行账户一个,工作空间一个电子邮件地址和一个出行),因此这一检测的一部分可能来自这些字符串;新的应用程序没有共享它们,在那里,我们的攻击级别仍然高于双胞胎(AUROC 0.92)。

blocks.en: In applications the probe never saw, ours still flags few clean twins and look-alikes (a median 6% and 10%, against 70% and 94% for the standard probe). Whether it catches the attacks depends on the model (Figure 3 ): with 5% of clean twins flagged, it catches clearly more than the standard probe for Qwen3-8B and Gemma-4, about as many for gpt-oss, slightly fewer for the two Nemotron models, and both are weak on Qwen3.5. Its scores are lower overall in new applications, so at the default threshold it flags only 58% of plain-text attacks (95% for the standard probe), although it ranks them above their clean twins better (AUROC 0.85 against 0.78; Table 10 ). Training on three applications instead of two does not change this picture (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 在应用中,探测器从未看到过,我们仍然很少标出干净的双胞胎和外观相似的双胞胎(中位数为6%和10%,标准探测器为70%和94%)。 是否接获攻击取决于型号(图3):有5%的干净双胞胎被标出,其接获量明显高于Qune3-8B和Gemma-4的标准探测器,Gpt-os大约相同多,两个Nemotron型号略为减少,在Qune3.5上两者都比较弱. 它的分数在新的应用中总体较低,因此在默认的阈值下,它只标出58%的纯文本攻击(标准探测器为95%),虽然它将双胞胎排在干净的双胞胎之上更好(AUROC 0.85对0.78;表10). 关于三个应用程序而不是两个应用程序的培训不会改变这一局面(附录E.)。

blocks.en: Table 2 adds each part of our training data to the standard data on its own, with the same classifier and layer. In seen applications, clean twins cut false alarms on twins from 57% to 22%. Adding every moment of the clean runs, which includes the twins, helps about as much, but adding the same number of clean moments from other positions helps much less (45%): what matters is clean data at the same moments as the attacks, which clean runs of the same tasks provide. Look-alikes remove most false alarms on look-alikes and halve those on harmless instructions, but leave many twins flagged. Only both together remove both shortcuts; plain-text positives change little. New applications show the same pattern, although there look-alikes cost some detection.
blocks.zh: 表2 将我国培训数据的每一部分单独列入标准数据,分类和分层相同。 在可见的应用中,干净的双胞胎将双胞胎的假警报从57%切到22%. 加上包括双胞胎在内的干净跑道的每分每分每秒都有帮助,但从其他位置上添加同样数量的干净跑道帮助则少得多(45%):重要的是在攻击的同时刻获得干净的数据,而清洁跑道提供同样的任务. 外观类去除外观类上大多数假警报,在无害指示下将假警报减半,但留下许多双胞胎标记. 只有两者一起去掉两个快捷键;纯正文变化不大. 新的应用显示相同的模式,尽管有外观类似物需要一些检测.

blocks.en: We treat each test application as live traffic in which 1% of tool outputs carry an attack, and assume the second check catches every attack it is sent. We call the attacks the agent fell for (by AgentDojo’s success check) successful attacks , and measure the share of them that the probe flags ( successful attacks stopped ) and the checks per million tool outputs (Figure 4 ). With the training-app threshold, ours stops more successful attacks than the standard probe in seen applications (a median 95% against 79%) with about as many checks. Most of this gain comes from the classifier, which already stops 91% on the standard data. Our data matters for false alarms: at this threshold, ours flags a median 2% of look-alikes, against 22% for the standard probe, although on harmless instructions the gap is small. In new applications ours stops 82%, against 80% for the standard probe, with fewer checks.
blocks.zh: 我们把每个测试应用程序视为1%的工具输出带有攻击的活流量,并假设第二次检查会捕获每次发送的攻击. 我们称这名特工为成功攻击(通过Dojo探员的成功检查), 在训练应用的门槛下,我们比在所见应用中的标准探测器(中位数95%对79%)更能成功阻止攻击,检查次数也差不多。 这一增益大多出自分类器,在标准数据上已经停止了91%. 我们的数据对虚假警报很重要:在这个阈值上,我们标出2%的外观,而标准探测器则标出22%的外观,尽管根据无害的指示,差距很小。 在新的应用中,我们停止82%, 而标准探测器的80%, 检查更少。

blocks.en: At the default threshold, the standard probe sends a median 315k of every million tool outputs to the second check in seen applications, against 74k for ours: about 88 against 21 hours of checking at one second per check (Table 6 ).
blocks.zh: 在默认阈值下,标准探测器将每百万个工具输出的中位数315克发送到所见应用的第二次检查中,而我们的检查为74克:大约88小时,每检查一秒检查21小时(表6)。

blocks.en: With the test-app threshold, the standard probe stops more successful attacks than ours in new applications (a median 87% against 74%) at a similar cost, while in seen applications ours stops more but needs more checks (Table 11 ). The reason is that a threshold flagging only 1% of normal tool outputs is strict enough to sit above most clean twins, while most successful attacks still score above it for every probe. Such a strict threshold thus hides most of the shortcut.
blocks.zh: 有了测试-应用阈值,标准探测器以类似的成本在新的应用(中位数87%对74%)中停止比我们的成功攻击,而在所见应用中,我们停止了更多,但需要更多的检查(表11)。 原因是一分阈值只标出正常工具输出的1%,其严格度足以坐到最干净的双胞胎之上,而大多数成功的攻击仍然在每一次探针的上方得分. 因此,这种严格的门槛掩盖了大部分捷径。

blocks.en: Our training look-alikes all use the formatted template, while our probe sees the other templates only inside attacks. A probe could therefore learn that a TODO: or ###(system_message) prefix means “attack”. To test this, we put the harmless test-half notices in those two templates, which should not be flagged. Trained on the standard data, our classifier flags most of them at the default threshold (a median 92% in seen and 69% in new applications). Ours flags far fewer (49% and 21%), but more than look-alikes in the formatted template it was trained on (11% and 10%). Ours also ranks the real attack above these look-alikes better (AUROC 0.94 against 0.85 in seen applications, 0.85 against 0.81 in new ones). The fix for formatting thus carries over to other templates only in part; training look-alikes in every template is the natural next step.
blocks.zh: 我们的训练外观都使用格式化的模板,而我们的探测器只看到内部攻击中的其他模板. 因此,一个探测器可以得知TODO:或QQ(system_message)前缀指"攻击". 为了测试这一点,我们把无害的测试半通知放在这两个模板中,不应该标出. 我们的分类员在标准数据方面进行了培训,他们大多在默认阈值下标出(在所看到的数据中位数为92%,在新的应用中为69%)。 我们的旗帜要少得多(49%和21%), 我们的实际攻击程度也高于这些外观(AUROC 0.94对所见应用的0.85, 0.85对新应用的0.81)。 因此,格式化的固定只部分地延伸到其他模板;每个模板中的培训外观是自然的下一步。

blocks.en: A first filter need not read hidden states. We also train a simple text classifier (TF-IDF with logistic regression) on the latest tool output, once on the standard data and once on ours (Table 10 ). It cannot see the position in the conversation, but trained on the standard data it still learns the formatting shortcut: in seen applications it flags 81% of look-alikes, and in new applications it scores most look-alikes above their clean twins. Trained on our data, it flags only 4% and ranks them below their twins, so our data helps a text filter too. On AgentDojo’s attacks, it tells attacks from twins as well as our probe or better. But it catches plain-text attacks less well, and its threshold does not carry over to new applications: there it stops 87% of successful attacks with a threshold set on the new application’s own traffic (74% for our probe), but only 38% with the training-app threshold (82% for our probe). A probe’s advantages are reused computation, plain-text attacks, and a threshold that carries over to new applications.
blocks.zh: 第一个过滤器不需要读取隐藏状态 。 我们还就最新的工具输出、一次标准数据、一次我们的数据(表10)培训一个简单的文本分类器(TF-IDF,后勤回归)。 它无法看到对话中的位置,但是在标准数据上受过训练,它仍然学习格式化快捷键:在所见的应用程序中,它标出81%的外观-类似物,在新的应用程序中,它评出最多的外观-类似物都高于他们的干净双胞胎. 根据我们的数据,它只标出4%的旗子, 并把它们排到双胞胎以下, 所以我们的数据也帮助一个文本过滤器。 在Dojo探员的攻击中,它讲述了双胞胎的攻击以及我们的探测器或更好的攻击。 但是,它捕捉到的纯文本攻击效果较差,其阈值并没有延续到新的应用上:它用设定新应用自身流量的阈值(我们的探测器为74%)阻止了87%的成功攻击,但只有38%的阈值(我们的探测器为82% ) 。 探测器的优点是再利用计算、纯文本攻击和新应用的门槛。

blocks.en: In new applications, the attacks ours misses are mostly ones the agent ignored: for four of six models, the agent fell for far fewer of them than of those ours catches (Table 9 ). On successful attacks, every probe ranks well.
blocks.zh: 在新的应用中,我们错过的攻击大多是被代理人忽略的攻击:在6个模型中,有4个模型的代理人比我们的渔获量少得多(表9)。 成功攻击时,每个探测器都排好

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Injection probes can pass the standard evaluation by tracking where the agent is in the conversation and how much text it has just read. Clean twins and look-alikes expose the false alarms this causes, which a deployed monitor pays for with second checks. Training with matched negatives removes most of the shortcut in applications seen during training, for every model we tested, while still stopping most successful attacks. In new applications the reduction in false alarms remains, but detection depends on the model and on how the threshold is set. Future work includes monitors that transfer to new applications and adaptive attacks on the hidden states. We recommend training injection monitors with clean runs of the same tasks and harmless look-alikes, and reporting a no-model baseline, a comparison against clean twins and the successful attacks stopped at a fixed false-alarm budget.
blocks.zh: 注射探针可以通过跟踪代理在对话中的位置以及它刚刚读取了多少文本来通过标准评价. 干净的双胞胎和长相暴露了虚假的警报,这导致部署的监视器用二次检查支付费用。 带有相匹配的底片的训练取消了训练期间所看到的应用程序中的大部分快捷方式,因为我们测试过的每个模型,同时仍然停止了大多数成功的攻击. 在新的应用中,假警报的减少仍然存在,但检测取决于模型和门槛的设定。 今后的工作包括监测员向新应用的转移以及对隐藏状态的适应性攻击。 我们建议培训注射监测员,配备同样的任务和无害的外观,并报告无模式基线,与干净的双胞胎进行比较,成功的攻击以固定的假警报预算停止。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We use one benchmark, AgentDojo; other agent environments, and real traffic with more instruction-like content, may expose other shortcuts, and our cost projection for such traffic (Appendix E ) is not a measurement. Our main look-alikes, both for training and for testing, use the formatted template; other templates are tested only as look-alikes (§ 6 ) and are otherwise used as positives. In new applications, detection depends on the model and on how the threshold is set, and our middle-of-the-model layer rule is not the best layer for every model (Appendix E ). Cost estimates assume that a second check takes about one second, as in reported examples ( Chennabasappa et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and a 1% attack rate, which is higher than estimates for web pages ( Khodayari et al., 2026 ) and close to that for resumes ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . All our runs use a single system prompt (Appendix A ). Our labels mark exposure to injected text, not whether the agent obeys it. Detection in seen applications may partly rest on AgentDojo’s reused attacker accounts (§ 6 ); we do not test with fresh accounts. We compare with a TF-IDF text classifier but not with trained text detectors such as Prompt Guard ( Meta, 2025 ) . We do not study adaptive attacks optimized against the probes ( Bailey et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们使用一个基准,AgentDojo;其他代理环境,以及具有更多类似指令内容的实际流量,可能暴露出其他快捷键,我们对这种流量的成本预测(Appendix E)并不是一个衡量. 我们的主要外观外观,无论是用于培训还是测试,都使用格式化的模板;其他模板仅作为外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观 在新的应用中,检测取决于模型以及阈值的设定方式,而我们的中模层规则并不是每个模型的最佳层(Appendix E. 成本估算假设第二次检查大约需要一秒钟,如所报告的例子(Chennabasappa等,2025年;Zhang等,2026年)和1%的攻击率,高于网页(Khodayari等,2026年)的估算值,接近复发率(Zhang等,2026年)。 我们的所有运行都使用单一的系统提示(Appendix A.). 我们的标签标注了注射文字的曝光,而不是代理人是否服从. 对所见应用的检测可能部分取决于Dojo特工的再利用攻击者账户(第6节);我们不使用新账户进行测试。 我们与一个TF-IDF文本分类器比较,但没有与训练有素的文本探测器,如"快速卫士"(Meta,2025). 我们不研究针对探测器的最佳适应性攻击(Bailey等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This work studies defenses against prompt injection. Our analysis shows how monitors can fail, which an attacker could in principle use, for example by placing injections where a shortcut-driven probe does not look. We do not release new attacks: all attack templates come from AgentDojo, and the harmless rewrites we add contain no harmful content. All data are synthetic, and no human subjects were involved. We used an AI assistant for code, literature search and grammar; the authors checked all code, results and text.
blocks.zh: 这项工作研究防即时注射的防御. 我们的分析显示,监视器可能失灵,攻击者原则上可以使用,例如将注射放入一个捷径驱动的探测器不看的地方。 我们不会发布新的攻击:所有攻击模板都来自Dojo探员,我们添加的无害重写没有有害的内容. 所有数据都是合成的,没有涉及人类主体. 我们在代码,文献搜索和语法方面使用了AI助手;作者检查了所有的代码,结果和文本.

blocks.en: Appendix A Data and Implementation
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据和执行

blocks.en: We use AgentDojo v1.2.2 and the collection pipeline of Dong et al. (2026) , serving each model with vLLM 0.19 on one GH200 GPU at temperature 1 with a 32K context and reasoning enabled. To cover every pair of user task and attacker task within our compute budget, we collect four disjoint quarters of the task grid (even or odd user tasks × \times even or odd attacker tasks), one sample each, with all six templates and clean runs. The pipeline’s configuration file defines only the default of its four named system prompts, and AgentDojo falls back to the default for unknown names, so every run uses the default prompt. Fewer than 2% of runs fail (time-outs and unparseable outputs) and are dropped. Collection and feature extraction took about 170 GPU-hours on NVIDIA GH200 GPUs, and probe training and analysis about 40 CPU node-hours. Two models needed small fixes to the released tool-call parsers, and one model’s features are extracted one prompt at a time.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Agent Dojo v1.2.2 和 Dong et al. (2026) 的收集管道,在温度1的一GH200 GPU上服务于每个型号的vLLM 0.19,并启用了32K上下文和推理. 为了在计算预算范围内覆盖每对用户任务和攻击者任务,我们收集了任务网格的四个脱节区块(偶数或奇数用户任务×\times even或奇数攻击者任务),每个样本一个,所有六个模板和干净运行. 管道的配置文件只定义了它四个被命名的系统提示的默认值,AgentDojo为未知名称倒回了默认值,因此每次运行都使用默认提示. 不到2%的运行失败(超时和无法分割的产出)被放弃。 采集和特征提取在NVIDIA GH200 GPU上花费了约170个GPU小时,并探测了约40个CPU节点小时的训练和分析. 有两个模型需要小的解析器,一个模型的特性一次抽取一次。

blocks.en: We train on the quarter with even user and even attacker tasks and test on the other three. A clean twin depends only on the user task, so a test attack on a training user task can share its clean twin with a training attack; we leave such attacks out, so that no probe is tested on a clean moment it was trained on. Almost all remaining test attacks therefore come from user tasks the probe has never seen.
blocks.zh: 我们用甚至用户甚至攻击者的任务在季度进行训练,并在其他三个方面进行测试。 一个干净的双胞胎只取决于用户任务,所以对训练用户任务进行测试攻击,就可以用训练攻击来分享它的干净的双胞胎;我们不考虑这种攻击,这样就没有任何探测器在它训练过的干净的时刻进行测试. 因此,几乎所有剩余的测试攻击都来自探测器从未见过的用户任务.

blocks.en: The conversation-statistics baseline uses the step number, the numbers of messages and of tool outputs so far, whether the latest message is a tool output, and the lengths of the prompt, of the latest tool output and of all tool outputs. Hidden states are read with forward hooks in transformers at the last token of the chat-template header that opens the agent’s reply (the token position is aligned across chat templates). The rewrites are rendered with each model’s own chat template and kept only if the unmodified prompt reproduces the collected token ids exactly, which holds for every kept item.
blocks.zh: 对话-统计基线采用步骤编号、信件数目和迄今工具产出的数目、最新消息是否为工具产出、以及即时、最新工具产出和所有工具产出的长度。 隐藏状态在打开代理回复的聊天-模板头的最后一个符号上用变压器中的前钩读取(该符号位置在聊天模板之间对齐). 重写是使用每个模型自己的聊天模板提供的,并且只有在未修改的即时复制了所收集的代号标识的准确性的情况下才予以保存,该标识符为每个保存的项目所保存。

blocks.en: Standard probes: one linear layer per model layer, AdamW, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , batch size 64, five epochs, standardized features, final checkpoint, logits averaged over five seeds. Logistic-regression probes: scikit-learn, C = 0.05 C=0.05 , balanced class weights, standardized features. Every probe picks its layer on 20% of its training tasks under its own training objective, with near-ties (within 0.005) broken toward the middle layer. Scores are kept as logits so that rankings survive where probabilities saturate. Intervals are 95% bootstrap intervals that resample user tasks and attacker tasks independently (Table 8 ). We call a difference clear when its interval excludes zero; we do not correct for multiple comparisons.
blocks.zh: 标准探测器:每个模型层一线性地层,亚当W,学习率10−4 10×4},批量尺寸64,5个纪元,标准化特征,最终检查点,对数平均超过5个种子. 逻辑后退探测器: scikit-learn C=0.05 C=0.05 平衡类重量,标准化特征. 每个探测器都根据自己的训练目标 选择了20%的训练任务 近50分(0.005分以内)向中层突破 分数被保留为对数,这样,在概率饱和的地方,排名就能够生存. 间隔是95%的靴子间隔,可以独立地重现用户任务和攻击者任务(表8). 我们称,当其间隔排除为零时,差异是明确的;我们并不正确进行多重比较。

blocks.en: Without the 20% of training tasks held out for layer choice, each model’s seen-application training data holds 4,683–5,701 attacked moments (positives) and 12,457–18,588 standard negatives. Our probe adds a twin, a look-alike and a plain-text attack for each of the 445–584 formatted-template attacks (the twins are 111–139 distinct moments, since one clean moment is the twin of every attack on its user task there), plus all 611–779 clean-run moments. In new applications, per training pair, these counts are 3,771–16,209, 11,749–46,134, 277–2,006, 70–236 and 445–1,039.
blocks.zh: 如果没有20%的培训任务供层层选择,每个模型的可见应用培训数据就有4,683–5,701个被攻击的时刻(阳性)和12,457–18,588个标准负数。 我们的探测器为445–584格式化-多端攻击(双胞胎是111–139个不同的时刻,因为一个干净的瞬间是其用户任务每次攻击的双胞胎),加上所有611–779个干净运行的时刻,都增加了双胞胎、外观和文字攻击。 在新的申请中,每对培训中,这些数目为3 771-16 209人、11 749-46 134人、277-2 006人、70-236人和445-1 039人。

blocks.en: Appendix B Counterfactual Injections
blocks.zh: 附录B 反事实注射

blocks.en: To check that the clean twin differs from the attack only in the injection, we replay each clean run’s own tool calls with the injection slots filled, for the first quarter of the task grid and four models (Qwen3-8B, Qwen3.5-9B and the two Nemotron models). The replay reproduces the clean prompts exactly, and in 85–89% of pairs the result is token for token the attacked prompt, because the injection usually arrives before the two runs diverge.
blocks.zh: 为了检查干净的双胞胎只与注射时的攻击不同,我们用所填入的注射槽重放每个干净跑道自己的工具呼叫,用于任务网格的第一季度和四个模型(Quen3-8B,Quen3.5-9B和两个Nemotron模型). 重播完全复制了干净的提示,在85-89%的对子中,结果为被攻击的提示的象征,因为注射通常在两者运行相差之前到达.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Four of the test cases at the same moment of the same task (texts shortened). The harmless instruction, not shown, replaces the injection with a plain sentence addressed to a human reader, such as “Please bring your laptop to Thursday’s workshop.” The real attack and the look-alike share the same formatting; the real attack and the plain-text attack share the same request. A probe that flags the look-alike is reacting to the formatting; a probe that flags the clean twin is reacting to the moment in the conversation rather than to anything in the text.

blocks.en: Table 4 gives every number behind Figures 2 and 3 and Table 1 , for all four probes and both settings. On seen-application test attacks whose attacker task is also new, ours keeps AUROC 0.95–0.99 against the twin and flags 3–28% of twins at the default threshold; it flags a median 94% of plain-text attacks and catches 95% when 5% of twins are flagged, against 97% and 96% for attacker tasks seen in training. Trained on the formatted template alone, our probe flags 30–55% of plain-text attacks in new applications, against 51–81% with all six templates.
blocks.zh: 表4列出了图2和图3以及表1后面的所有四个探测器和两种设置的每个数字。 在攻击者的任务也是新的可见应用测试攻击中,我们的AUROC将0.95–0.99对双胞胎和3–28分旗的双胞胎保持在默认阈值;它标出94%的纯文字攻击中位数,当5%的双胞胎被标出时捕获95%,而97%和96%用于训练中看到的攻击者任务。 我们的探测器只训练了格式化的模板, 在新应用中标出30-55 %的纯文本攻击, 而所有6个模板都标出51-81%。

blocks.en: Table 5 compares training on two applications (all six pairs) with training on three and testing on the fourth. The AUROC against the clean twin changes by at most 0.04, so adding a third training application does not close the gap in new applications.
blocks.zh: 表5将两种应用(所有6对)的培训与三种应用和第四种应用的测试进行比较。 AUROC与干净的双子变化相比最多为0.04,所以加上第三个训练应用程序并不能弥补新应用程序中的缺口.

blocks.en: Table 6 gives the per-model numbers behind Figure 4 , including our classifier on the standard data (LR), and Table 7 the full ablation of Section 6 . The deployment numbers rest on 48–163 successful attacks per model in seen applications and 111–318 in new ones. At the training-app threshold, ours flags a median 2% of look-alikes and 12% of harmless instructions in seen applications (standard probe 22% and 14%, our classifier on the standard data 44% and 24%) and 12% and 14% in new ones (52% and 35%; 29% and 19%). In new applications, ours is clearly ahead of our classifier on the standard data for four models, and ahead of the standard probe for two and behind it for two.

blocks.en: Table 9 lists, for new applications, how often the agent fell for the attacks that ours misses and catches, where the misses are, and how well each probe ranks successful attacks and the ones the agent ignored. For gpt-oss and Gemma-4, the agent fell for the missed and the caught attacks about equally often. On successful attacks, ours ranks clearly better than the other probes only for Gemma-4 and Qwen3.5.
